chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Isa ibn Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib, from Abu Abd Allah (عليه السلام), who said:
I said to him, "If an event should occur—and may Allah not show me that—then whom should I follow as Imam?" He said: he gestured toward his son Musa (عليه السلام).

I said, "If an event should occur to Musa, then whom should I follow as Imam?" He said, "His son." I said, "If an event should occur to his son, and he leaves behind an older brother and a young son, then whom should I follow as Imam?" He said, "His son."

Then he said, "Thus it will always be." I said, "If I do not know him, nor know his location?" He said, "You should say: O Allah, I hold allegiance to whoever remains from Your proofs, from the offspring of the previous Imam. Indeed, that will suffice you, if Allah wills."

key_terms.أَئْتَمُّ: I take as Imam; I follow in religious authority
key_terms.أَتَوَلَّى: I hold allegiance to; I take in wilayah and loyalty
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ الْمَاضِي: the previous Imam; the Imam who has passed away
key_terms.حُجَجِكَ: Your proofs; Allah’s divinely appointed authorities upon creation
key_terms.مَوْضِعَهُ: his location; the place where he is
key_terms.مُوسَى: Musa ibn Ja'far (عليه السلام), indicated here as the succeeding Imam
key_terms.وَلَدِهِ: his son; indicating succession through the son

ai.seo_question: How should one identify and show allegiance to the Imam after the passing of the previous Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith sets out the principle of the Imamate passing through the son, and affirms a continuous divinely designated authority among the descendants of the previous Imam. It also teaches a du'a for one who does not know the present Hujjah, expressing wilayah toward the remaining proof of Allah from the line of the past Imam.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Najran, 
(It has been narrated) from Isa Bin Abdullah Bin Muhammad Bin Umar, son of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Abu Talib<sup>asws</sup>, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘If it does happen, and may Allah<sup>azwj</sup> not Show me that, so with one should I take as an Imam<sup>asws</sup>?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> gestured towards his<sup>asws</sup> son<sup>asws</sup> Musa<sup>asws</sup>’.

I said, ‘So if It occurs with Musa<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> an occurrence (of death), so with whom should I take as an Imam<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘With his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> son<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’. I said, ‘Supposing there occurs with his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> son<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> an occurrence (of death), and he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> leaves a lot of brothers and young sons, so with whom should I take as an Imam<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘With his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> son<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’.

Then he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘This is how it will be for ever!’. I said, ‘Supposing I do not reconise him<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> nor do I recognise his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> place?’ He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> said: ‘You should be saying, 
‘O Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>! I hereby take as a Guardian the one<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> who remains from Your<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> Divine Authority, from a son<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> of the past Imam<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>’. So that would suffice you, if Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> so Desires’.
en.sarwar: 7. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu Najran from ‘Isa ibn ‘Abdallah ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Umar ibn Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) who has said the following.

“I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.). “If something would happen (death of Imam), may Allah will not make me experience it, then who must I follow as my Imam?” The narrator has said that he pointed to his son Musa (a.s.).
I then asked, “What if something will happen to Musa (a.s.) then who must I follow as my Imam?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Follow his sons.

Then he said, “In this way for ever.” I then asked, “What if I will not know him and will not know his place?” The Imam (a.s.) said, “Say, ‘O Lord, I love and take as my guardian whoever is left (on earth) as your authority of the sons of the preceding Imam. This will be enough for you if Allah would so will.”
